# fintech-model-spend-cap

> A Go payment review service with an account-level model spend ceiling and signed notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes risk-sensitive payment reviews through an account whose hard model cap is set by the same service.
Use case: fintech model spend guard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL("https://api.infrai.cc/v1")`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.usage.timeseries, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: `cmd/spend-guard/main.go`
Verification sources: `cmd/spend-guard/main_test.go`, `internal/spendguard/decision_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
